name: adversarial-test
description: Adversarial manual testing: a clean-context Test Adversary subagent runs the real product surface in isolated state and tries to break it; every reproduction is rerun before it counts.

interface.shortDescription: Adversarial manual testing of a change
interface.longDescription: Adversarial Test from the SAI Codex collection. A clean-context Test Adversary subagent derives acceptance criteria, runs the real service, CLI, or sandbox in isolated state, and attacks it; the caller reruns every reproduction to drop hallucinated failures. Falls back to an inline pass when spawning fails.
